Extracts a signature from a (gene x seed) matrix of stationary probability values. This is the recontextualized signature. If doing ks.test, you don't need to find the top_n. Just find ks.test(original, recontextualized ranking) before and after.

Source: R/baseline_methods.R
extract_sig_mat.Rd

Extracts a signature from a (gene x seed) matrix of stationary probability values. This is the recontextualized signature. If doing ks.test, you don't need to find the top_n. Just find ks.test(original, recontextualized ranking) before and after.

Usage

extract_sig_mat(
  mat,
  bootstraps = NULL,
  sig_bins = NULL,
  percentile = 0.99,
  limit = 30
)

Arguments

mat

(n_gene, n_seed) matrix of stationary probability values from rwr_mat

bootstraps

A (n_gene, n_bins*n_bootstraps) matrix specifying results from bootstrapped random walks.

sig_bins

A named list describing the length of each perturbation.

percentile

A double between 0,1 indicating the proportion cutoff for bootstrap-based signature derivation.

limit

Number of genes to keep in the output, or a vector of lengths. Default is 30.

Value

A named list of genesets. Each list element is the recontextualized signature for that seed.
